Name: Perfect Harvest
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
🌟 Perfect Harvest
[b]Always harvest the highest-quality crops in Stardew Valley![/b]
Perfect Harvest is a simple, lightweight cheat mod that guarantees your harvested crops are [b]Iridium Quality[/b]. No more Normal, Silver, or Gold-quality crops — when you harvest an eligible crop, you get the highest quality available.
[heading]✨ Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]🌟 [b]Guaranteed Iridium Quality[/b] — harvested crops are automatically upgraded to Iridium quality. [/*]
[*]🚫 [b]No lower-quality results[/b] — Normal, Silver, and Gold crop qualities are replaced with Iridium. [/*]
[*]🌱 [b]Works with regular crop harvesting[/b] — simply harvest your crops normally. [/*]
[*]⚡ [b]Simple and lightweight[/b] — no complicated gameplay systems or unnecessary features. [/*]
[*]🎮 [b]Cheat-friendly[/b] — perfect for players who want to maximize crop value or experiment with farming. [/*]
[*]💾 [b]Safe and convenient[/b] — designed to work without changing the normal way you harvest crops. [/*]
[/list][heading]🥕 How It Works[/heading]
Normally, crop quality can vary when you harvest:
[b]Normal → Silver → Gold → Iridium[/b]
With Perfect Harvest enabled:
[b]Harvest Crop → 🌟 Iridium Quality[/b]
That's it.
You don't need special fertilizer, machines, extra processing, or a minimum Farming level to activate the effect.
[heading]🌾 Example[/heading]
Without Perfect Harvest:
[quote]Harvest Pumpkin
→ Normal Quality 🎃
→ Silver Quality 🥈
→ Gold Quality 🥇
→ Iridium Quality 💜[/quote]With Perfect Harvest:
[quote]Harvest Pumpkin
→ [b]Iridium Quality 💜[/b][/quote]Every eligible harvested crop receives the highest quality.
[heading]🎯 Why Use Perfect Harvest?[/heading]
Perfect Harvest is designed for players who want a [b]simple farming cheat[/b] without installing a large cheat menu or changing dozens of unrelated game mechanics.
It's useful if you want to:
[list]
[*]💰 Maximize farming profits [/*]
[*]🌱 Build a high-value farming operation quickly [/*]
[*]🧪 Experiment with high-quality crops [/*]
[*]🏆 Create a "perfect farm" [/*]
[*]😎 Simply enjoy guaranteed premium harvests [/*]
[/list][heading]⚙️ Compatibility[/heading]
Perfect Harvest is designed as a lightweight Stardew Valley mod and does not attempt to replace the normal farming system.
For installation, make sure you have the required framework listed in the [b]Requirements[/b] section.
[heading]📦 Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/*]
[*]Download [b]Perfect Harvest[/b]. [/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]PerfectHarvest[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder. [/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Start harvesting! 🌟 [/*]
[/list][heading]⚠️ Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]This mod is intended as a [b]cheat/gameplay enhancement[/b]. [/*]
[*]It changes the quality of harvested crops, so crop profits can increase significantly. [/*]
[*]Keep a backup of your save if you're experimenting with heavily modified gameplay. [/*]
[*]Other mods that modify crop quality may conflict with Perfect Harvest. [/*]
[/list][heading]💜 Credits[/heading]
Thanks for downloading and supporting [b]Perfect Harvest[/b]!
If you enjoy the mod, consider [b]endorsing it on Nexus Mods[/b] and leaving a comment. Feedback and bug reports are always appreciated.
